# [CS070] Large File (large-file)

A file is longer than metrics.max_file_loc lines.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Code Metrics |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Very long files (default limit 600 lines) usually hold several concerns. Split them by type or feature.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
// server.go: 1,800 lines of handlers, middleware and storage
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
// handlers.go, middleware.go, storage.go
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [large-file]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    large-file: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore large-file -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** large-file
```
